title: EliteWheels Drive II // They Fixed MOST of the Issues.

takeaways.text: The 50 mm Drive II pair weighed about 1,330 g with tape and valves, the same as the first generation despite rims about 2 mm wider (23 mm internal, about 30 mm external, reduced hook); both sets were supplied free.

Generation II adds captured spoke heads in the hubs, wider 4.5 mm carbon spokes (21 front, 24 rear, spares included) and a conical ratchet hub with O-ring end caps; rims are drilled with pre-installed tape.

The stock 50-tooth ratchet was the loudest freehub he had owned, loud enough to stop conversation; Elitewheels sent a quieter 36-tooth ratchet that fixed it. The supplied tubeless valves remained too short for a floor pump.
With 32 mm road tires at about 50 psi they felt fast and responsive without harshness, stayed true and ran tubeless without problems over a couple of months.

disclosure: The description offers a 20% Elitewheels discount code and links the creator’s shop; it does not say how the wheels were obtained.
summary: Ride review of the Drive II 50D road wheels that weighs which concerns with the original Drive wheels were fixed and which one remains.
